questionEn: Which of the following corresponds to the material in the paragraph “Pure substances and mixtures”?
questionUz: Quyidagilardan qaysi biri “Sof moddalar va aralashmalar” bandidagi materialga mos keladi?
choicesEn: A substance that is separated by physical methods into pure substances
choicesUz: Fizik usullar bilan toza moddalarga ajratiladigan modda
